third_party_evaluations.summary: Two-exam SOC analyst track (CBRCOR + CBRFIR) covering advanced detection, automation, forensics and IR using Cisco tooling.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Advanced detection, automation and forensics across two exams support professional SOC responsibility at three years; the recorded Cisco-tooling emphasis limits vendor-independent incident-response inference.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The recorded two-exam coverage of detection, automation, forensics and response fits professional SOC delivery with three years of experience. Cisco-tool concentration and no explicit practical assessment limit evidence of cross-platform incident leadership.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded two-exam track covers detection, automation, forensics and response at a three-year level. Its breadth supports professional SOC delivery knowledge, though Cisco dependence and unspecified practical assessment limit the ceiling.
